errors.text_span: На графиката е изобразена една синя линия, отбелязана с малки кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart displays two separate lines: a solid blue line and a dotted blue line. The description incorrectly interprets this as a single line with markers.

errors.text_span: След това линията се стабилизира около стойност 31,0
errors.evidence: This statement is an oversimplification. The line does not stabilize; it continues to decrease to a minimum value of approximately 29.5 before rising again. The description completely misses this trough.
The description completely fails to mention the second, dotted line. The caption mentions "Изменение и тренд" (Change and trend), indicating the presence of two distinct data series.
